pos.personaBrief: Trivela describes a Jogo de Posição side with 70%+ possession in the final and Filipe states the aim is to be protagonist and dominate attacking actions, so ball-based control, not counter-attacking.

pro.personaBrief: TFA and Trivela show quick short passing, 3-2 build-up with Jorginho and Pulgar dropping, and playing out under press (errors v Bayern came from build-up, yet he kept the style).

est.personaBrief: Positional play with fluid zone occupation, frequent rotations, a winger or Gerson moving to the ball-near side, and Bruno Henrique dropping, within a defined structure.

lar.personaBrief: TFA stresses an extremely narrow shape with width given by one player on the ball-near side, and a 4-2-3-1 with attacking full-backs; little reliance on touchline wingers.

blo.personaBrief: Trivela and TFA: high press in waves, pressing forward from a 4-4-2 into an asymmetric 4-3-3, strong counter-press, with mid and low block as other phases; only four goals conceded early.

mar.personaBrief: Evidence is weak: pair-matching in the press (striker v CB, winger v full-back) is man-oriented, within a zonal 4-4-2 mid-block; no star-marking evidence, and defending is mostly spatial.

pla.personaBrief: Filipe: never change my team because of an opponent, the idea was chosen and players bought in, protagonist approach even against Chelsea and Bayern; he imposed his model on arrival.

res.personaBrief: He wants to win through proposing play and dominance, not settling for draws; in the final he controlled tempo and lowered lines when needed, so ambitious yet pragmatic.

sis.personaBrief: A system-driven collective: roles defined, Arrascaeta/Pedro alternated for balance, tactical intelligence required of all, with demands of everyone and no freedom for stars.

jog.personaBrief: Technical, short-passing positional football with Arrascaeta as creator and Jorginho/Pulgar as passing pivots, though intensity of pressing is also demanded.

bas.personaBrief: He leaned on experienced figures (Danilo, Léos, Jorginho, Saul) to win the title, with limited minutes for youth when fighting for the lead; the club's goal is titles.

lid.personaBrief: Stable, home-like environment with players as leaders and Rodrigo Caio on staff, yet Filipe is clearly in charge and picks the XI (preferring Danilo, rotating) without shouting.
